title: ixora baileyana
intro: Ixora baileyana, commonly known as the scarlet eye or wild jasmine, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of the Pacific Islands. It is valued for its vibrant red flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation, and treating infections. The bioactive constituents of Ixora baileyana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
